result.detail: Podio API key (client ID/secret) is self-service: sign in, open the API key tab in settings. OAuth2 server-side flow then shows any logged-in Podio user a consent screen. The only registration constraint is that redirect_uri must be on the domain given at registration. The docs I read (/authentication, /authentication/server_side, /api-key) say nothing about vendor review, approval, listing, or install/user caps. Podio terms and the scopes page were not checked, so this rests on the absence of any stated gate.
result.quote: You just have to sign in or sign up with Podio, and go to the API key tab in your settings.
